title: Mooncake Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for Mooncake configuration files

artifact.capture.description: Capture file changes with enhanced metadata for LLM agents

embed_plan.description: Embed full plan in artifact for LLM context

max_diff_size.description: Maximum diff size in bytes per file

max_plan_steps.description: Don't embed plan if exceeds this many steps

name.description: Name of the artifact (used for output directory)

steps.description: Steps to execute while capturing changes

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns for allowed file paths

artifact_file.description: Path to artifact metadata JSON file

forbidden_paths.description: Glob patterns for forbidden file paths

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes after changes

max_files.description: Maximum number of files allowed to change

require_tests.description: Require test file changes when code files change

assert.description: Verify conditions without changing system state

cmd.description: Execute commands directly without shell interpolation

cmd_action.description: Execute commands directly without shell interpolation

container.description: Manage container lifecycle (running/stopped/absent) via podman or docker

container.image.description: Manage container images (pull/remove) via podman or docker

file.copy.description: Copy files with checksum verification and atomic writes

file.download.description: Download files from URLs with checksum verification

file.template.description: Render template files and write to destination

file.unarchive.description: Extract archive files (tar, tar.gz, zip) with path traversal protection

file.write.description: Manage files, directories, links, and permissions

state.description: Desired file state (file/present: file exists, absent: removed, directory: dir exists, link: symlink, hardlink: hard link, touch: update timestamp, perms: change permissions only)

git.checkout.description: Switch an existing git working tree to a specified ref

git.clone.description: Idempotently clone or update a git repository at a specific ref

git.config.description: Idempotently manage git config keys at local, global, or system scope

os.mount.description: Manage an /etc/fstab entry and the matching live mount

os.service.description: Manage services across platforms (systemd, launchd, Windows)

daemon_reload.description: Run 'systemctl daemon-reload' after unit file changes (systemd only)

enabled.description: Enable service to start on boot (systemd: enable/disable, launchd: bootstrap/bootout)

os.ssh_key.description: Manage authorized_keys entries for a user (idempotent per-key)

os.systemd.description: Manage a systemd unit file with daemon-reload, enable, start

os.user.description: Declaratively manage a system user account

manager.description: Package manager (auto-detected if empty: apt, dnf, yum, pacman, zypper, apk, brew, port, choco, scoop)

state.description: Package state (present: installed, absent: removed, latest: install or upgrade)

update_cache.description: Update package cache before operation (e.g., apt-get update)

pkg.hold.description: Mark or unmark packages as held to prevent upgrade/removal (apt only in v1)

pkg.list.description: Return the installed packages and versions (read-only; apt only in v1)

pkg.repo.description: Manage a third-party package repository (apt; dnf/brew deferred)

pkg.upgrade.description: Upgrade named packages or all installed packages (apt only in v1)

repo.patch.description: Apply multiple patches to multiple files atomically

repo.search.description: Search codebase for patterns and output results in JSON format

repo.tree.description: Generate a JSON representation of directory structure

runConfig.description: Structured configuration with version, global variables, and steps

vars.description: Global variables available to all steps

capture.description: Capture command output (default: true). When false, output is only streamed

error_action.description: Windows + PowerShell only — sets $ErrorActionPreference (Stop, Continue, SilentlyContinue, ...). Default: Stop. Ignored elsewhere.

interpreter.description: Shell interpreter binary (any executable on PATH). Default: bash on Unix, powershell on Windows. On Windows, 'cmd' dispatches with /c, others with -Command.

run_as_admin.description: Windows only — assert the mooncake process is elevated; fail the step if it isn't. Does not attempt UAC. Ignored on Unix.

stdin.description: Input to provide to the command via stdin
